snippet.title: Songs of Silence - Crownless King Expansion | Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:

While kingdoms crumble across Sonnan and Irdheim, Thorn and his ragtag family of rogues carve out a cozy existence on the edge of the Silence. But comfort rarely lasts, and before long they find themselves thrust into the spotlight…

It is only a matter of time before lurking foes or the Silence itself divide what remains. Unless one man steps forward and lifts the forsaken crown from the dirt.

Join the troop of rogues in both Campaign and Skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!
